section_summary.extract_value: This discussion summarizes findings from a single study of 326 middle-aged Saudi women, reporting low body appreciation and a mean BMI of 29.64 (SD 5.82) with ~55% classified as obese. The authors note that body appreciation was negatively associated with BMI (no coefficient reported for this sample), link BA to weight-loss efforts, and call for more research and health-education interventions for middle-aged women.

section_summary.extract_value: The Discussion summarizes findings from a single study of 326 middle-aged Saudi women showing low body appreciation (mean 3.92±2.43), high mean BMI (29.64±5.82) with 54.3% obese, and widespread weight-loss attempts. The authors report that body appreciation was negatively associated with BMI and argue BA mediates the relationship between BMI and weight-loss behavior; no study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') or multiple subsamples are indicated in the provided text.
